Legume Group

Lentils

About This Group

Lentils cook quickly without soaking and range from soft, sweet red lentils to earthy green and black varieties that hold their shape, making them a staple across South Asian, Middle Eastern, and French cooking.

Dried lentils used in dal, soups, and pulse cookery, including green lentil, red lentil, and brown lentil.
